verses.gurmukhi: ਬਨਜ ਬਿਉਹਾਰ ਬਿਖੈ ਰਤਨ ਪਾਰਖ ਹੋਇ ਰਤਨ ਜਨਮ ਕੀ ਪਰੀਖਿਆ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: banaj biauhaar bikhai ratan paarakh hoi ratan janam kee pareekhiaa nahee paiee hai ||

en.bdb: In the profession of trading, a man can assess and evaluate pearls and diamonds but has not been able to evaluate this precious human birth and his aim of coming to this world.

verses.gurmukhi: ਲੇਖੈ ਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਗੁਪਤ ਸੇ ਲੇਖਕ ਲਿਖਾਰੀ ਭਏ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਕੀ ਅਸੰਕਾ ਨ ਮਿਟਾਈ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: lekhai chitr gupat se lekhak likhaaree bhe janam maran kee asa(n)kaa na miTaiee hai ||

en.bdb: One can be a good accountant and expert in keeping accounts but has not been able to erase the repeated cycle of his birth and death.

verses.gurmukhi: ਬੀਰ ਬਿਦਿਆ ਮਹਾ ਬਲੀ ਭਏ ਹੈ ਧਨੁਖ ਧਾਰੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਨ ਸਹਜਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: beer bidhiaa mahaa balee bhe hai dhanukh dhaaree haumai maar na sahaj liv laiee hai ||

en.bdb: In the profession of fighting in the battlefields, a man may become very brave, strong and powerful, acquire sound knowledge of archery, but has failed to overpower his internal enemies of ego and pride so as to acquire spiritual stability through the teachings of the Guru.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਸੇਵ ਕਲੀਕਾਲ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੈ ਉਦਾਸੀ ਗੁਰਸਿਖਨ ਜਤਾਈ ਹੈ ॥੪੫੫॥
verses.translit_en: pooran braham gurdhev sev kaleekaal maiaa mai udhaasee gursikhan jataiee hai ||455||

en.bdb: Living in the world of maya (mammon), the disciples of the Guru who have remained unsoiled of it have learnt that in this dark eons, the meditation on the name of God-like True Guru is supreme.  (455)
